metadata.overview: A simulated three-phase power meter for the Operation Center Lite dev stack: one per container, reporting the same channels as the ABB and SATEC meter workers (active_power in W, voltage in V, current in A). Read-only; it has no commands.

telemetry.name: active_power
telemetry.description: Total active power through the meter.

telemetry.name: snap
telemetry.description: Every reading in one call: { active_power, voltage, current }.

errors.ERR_DEVICE_CALL_FAILED: The simulator's HTTP API call failed or returned an error.
